# Vendored lint configuration provenance

The unmodified package entrypoints/manifests in `eslint-config-js` (4.1.0) and `eslint-config-jsdoc` (1.0.1) come from [notmike101/eslint-configs](https://github.com/notmike101/eslint-configs/tree/48a765fb81a92695b779f9b5d95272dca0a1f402/packages), commit `48a765fb81a92695b779f9b5d95272dca0a1f402`, retrieved 2026-11-01.

These are private-package manifests, consumed only locally via npm file dependencies, never published to a registry. Vendoring permits reproducible `npm ci` and public CI without private registry/account credentials. The application uses the JavaScript config and the JSDoc syntax entrypoint, with documented local conventions in eslint.config.js. Module interfaces/domain records additionally carry explicit JSDoc. The upstream repository supplies no license file in these packages; no new license grant is asserted here.
